input: We treated mice bearing KRAS G12C tumors with AMG-510 for 14 days and observed >80% tumor regression in 6/8 animals. Treatment was well tolerated with no significant weight loss.

meta.claim: AMG-510 caused tumor regression in KRAS G12C mouse models.

input: Patients carrying the APOE e4 allele showed accelerated cognitive decline in a longitudinal cohort of 1,200 individuals over 5 years (HR 1.8, p<0.001).

meta.claim: APOE e4 carriers experienced faster cognitive decline than non-carriers.

input: In our randomized trial, the experimental compound failed to improve overall survival versus standard of care (HR 1.02, 95% CI 0.85-1.22).

meta.claim: The experimental compound improved overall survival compared to standard of care.

input: We sequenced 50 patient tumors and identified recurrent mutations in PIK3CA, TP53, and EGFR. No mutations were found in BRCA1 or BRCA2.

meta.claim: BRCA1 mutations were enriched in this tumor cohort.

input: Our CRISPR screen in pancreatic cancer cells identified MYC and KRAS as essential genes. Hits were validated with individual sgRNAs.

meta.claim: The screen identified BRD4 as an essential gene.

input: Single-cell RNA-seq of tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes revealed three exhausted CD8+ T cell subpopulations distinguished by TOX, PD-1, and LAG-3 expression.

meta.claim: Tumor-infiltrating regulatory T cells expressed high FOXP3.

input: Administration of GLP-1 receptor agonist semaglutide reduced body weight by 14.9% over 68 weeks versus 2.4% with placebo (STEP 1 trial, n=1961, p<0.001).

meta.claim: Semaglutide produced substantially greater weight loss than placebo in adults with obesity.

input: We observed that fasting glucose was reduced by 30 mg/dL in the treatment arm. HbA1c, however, was unchanged at 12 weeks.

meta.claim: HbA1c was reduced in the treatment arm at 12 weeks.

input: AlphaFold2 produced confident structure predictions (pLDDT > 90) for 76% of the human proteome, including most soluble globular proteins.

meta.claim: AlphaFold2 generated high-confidence predictions for the majority of human proteins.

input: Treatment with the JAK1 inhibitor reduced IL-6 signaling as measured by phospho-STAT3 in PBMCs. Adverse events included thrombocytopenia in 12% of patients.

meta.claim: JAK1 inhibition reduced phospho-STAT3 in patient blood cells.

input: In the Phase 3 trial, the primary endpoint of progression-free survival was met (HR 0.65, p<0.001). Overall survival data were immature at the time of analysis.

meta.claim: The trial demonstrated improved overall survival.

input: CAR-T therapy against CD19 achieved complete remission in 81% of pediatric ALL patients. Cytokine release syndrome occurred in 77% but was generally manageable.

meta.claim: CD19 CAR-T therapy induced complete remission in most pediatric ALL patients.

input: Mendelian randomization analysis using 80 genetic instruments suggested no causal effect of vitamin D levels on cardiovascular disease risk.

meta.claim: Vitamin D levels causally affect cardiovascular disease risk.

input: We performed proteomic profiling of cerebrospinal fluid in early Alzheimer's patients and identified 14 differentially abundant proteins, including SNAP25 and YKL-40.

meta.claim: Tau protein levels were elevated in the CSF samples.

input: The novel small molecule selectively inhibited mutant IDH1 R132H with IC50 of 24 nM, sparing wild-type IDH1 (IC50 > 10 µM).

meta.claim: The compound is selective for mutant IDH1 over wild-type IDH1.

input: Antibody A neutralized SARS-CoV-2 wild-type and Delta variants but lost potency against Omicron BA.1 (>100-fold reduction).

meta.claim: Antibody A retained full neutralization potency against Omicron BA.1.

input: Microbiome transplant from lean donors did not significantly alter body weight in obese recipients at 6 months, despite engraftment of donor strains.

meta.claim: Fecal microbiota transplant from lean donors induced weight loss in obese recipients.

input: Polygenic risk scores explained 7% of variance in coronary artery disease in the European-ancestry validation cohort.

meta.claim: Polygenic risk scores transferred well to African-ancestry populations.
